assessment.diversity_evidence: All stories share the same pottery-gift setup and mishap, followed by firing and Grandpa using the result. Most are near duplicates: thumb-rest variants (s000014, s000017, s000034, s000042, s000039, s000024, s000038, s000007), bowl conversions (s000058, s000036, s000053, s000021, s000048, s000057, s000018, s000041), and smoothed-dent cup endings (s000023, s000002, s000035). These few examples show little variation in plot or language.
